failure_modes.description: Custom parsing and data extraction logic fails to match the exact subset, schema, or address mapping expected by the reference test harness.
failure_modes.needed_instead: A robust pre-existing parsing utility or alignment guide that matches the reference test harness's exact extraction and filtering rules.

success_habits.description: Using low-level history investigation tools (such as reflog) to locate lost commits or changes prior to integration.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: The agent fails to locate missing changes or lost state, leading to incomplete task resolution.

success_habits.description: Explicitly resolving merge conflicts during branch operations using targeted checkout strategies and continuing the workflow.
success_habits.risk_if_broken: The workflow aborts or leaves the working tree in a conflicted state when patches or cherry-picks fail to apply cleanly.
